default_scope: The normalized default numerical operations, branch code, cache, force, equations and gates are source-AST exact. This is not a runtime byte-equality test: elapsed timings and provenance SHA fields naturally differ for changed source bytes.
opt_in_scope: Only displacement initial guess differs. The actual tangent KKT predicts dR, all original Newton/J/Armijo/mean/fixed/bisection rules still decide success. Different input node increments are allowed; no rigid input tie is added.
trace_interpretation: mean_error_before_projection is measured after the distributed adjustment and before original feasible() rounding correction; mean_error_after_projection is the actual post-correction residual. It is not a claim that the unapplied KKT dw candidate was used.
residual_risks: Distributed feasibility still cannot guarantee positive J or convergence
Tangent dR corresponds to the discarded displacement predictor and is only an initial reaction estimate
Generic nonzero affine lift is supported by current impose-based source but still needs the planned actual test
Static review gives no new contact/clamp/pressure/full-cycle or fresh HP qualification
required_next: Root freezes a new finite meaningful validation card and executes existing default tests plus opt-in invalid-predictor/valid-projected seed, free-port non-tie, affine lift, fixed DOFs and ordered loading/unloading cases. Actual side18 full cycle and all-N fresh reference follow only after that proof.
